other_failure_modes.name: Reusing validation set for early stopping and ensemble optimization
other_failure_modes.description: The agent uses the same validation set to early-stop gradient boosting models and to subsequently optimize the weights for the model ensemble. Because early stopping biases the models' predictions towards the validation set, the ensemble weights are optimized on overfitted predictions, which can lead to sub-optimal generalization on unseen test data. A separate holdout set should be used for ensemble weighting.
